sources.citation: Fabian, Grace, Edmund Fabian & Bruce Waters. 1998. Morphology, syntax and cohesion in Nabak, Papua New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics C-144. Canberra: ANU. x+490 pp.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online; also held in print at Harvard (Widener Library (offsite storage))
sources.note: Nothing. Only an orthography note (Intro p. ix-x: consonant/vowel symbols, allophones) and Ch. 1 Morphophonemics; a full-text search for stress/accent gives no hit; the only prosodic remark is 3.6 'Polar interrogatives are formed.. by changing the intonation contour so that pitch rises at the end of the sentence.' Intro p. x refers phonology to Fabian et al. (1971).

sources.citation: McElhanon, Kenneth A. 1979. A fresh look at Nabak morphophonemics. Kivung 12(1): 74-88.
sources.note: Nothing. Consonant phoneme/allophone table (p. 74), vowel phonemes, distinctive-feature matrix (note 4), generative reanalysis of the coda neutralisation. No suprasegmental statement in the 15 scanned pages.

sources.citation: McElhanon, K. A. 1973. Towards a typology of the Finisterre-Huon languages, New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics B-22. 73 pp.
sources.harvard_location: Divinity School Library (offsite storage), call number - Ask at Circulation (Pamph. folio) BS 354 .Z91
sources.note: Nothing. Morphological/grammatical comparison; Nabak verb paradigms in the appendix; note 3 (p. 67) only says the author's 1968 tentative analysis of Nabak consonant phonemes differs from the Fabians' (1971). No stress/accent/tone hits.

sources.citation: Fabian, Edmund, Grace Fabian & Charles Peck. 1971. The morphophonemics of Nabak. Kivung 4(3): 147-160.
sources.note: Nothing. Syllable pattern (C)V(C) and consonant-cluster table p. 147; consonant morphophonemics pp. 148-158; tentative phoneme inventory with phonetic values in note 1, pp. 158-159. No mention of stress, accent, tone or length (scan scanned at 300 dpi, all 14 pages).

sources.citation: Hooley, Bruce A. & Kenneth A. McElhanon. 1970. Languages of the Morobe District, New Guinea. In S. A. Wurm & D. C. Laycock (eds), Pacific Linguistic Studies in Honour of Arthur Capell, 1065-1094. Pacific Linguistics C-13.
sources.note: Regional survey cited by Glottolog for Nabak subclassification; low chance of a stress statement but it is the other pre-1971 first-hand source.

sources.citation: WALS Online, languoid nab (Nabak); Grambank naba1256; Wikipedia 'Nabak language'
sources.note: WALS and Grambank cite only Fabian et al. 1998 and show no stress/tone feature values for Nabak; Wikipedia gives consonant/vowel inventories only and no stress statement.
